'''2004 Florida State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 26 June 2004 at Sci-Fi City in Orlando, Florida. A player who signed as Keith (forum handle primal) organized it, and the prize support was the Players Committee's "Ultimate Package".<ref name="pcf-3469-47551">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47551#47551 Florida States, June 26th. Ultimate Prize Package...], primal, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040701184656/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47701%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Sci-Fi City, Orlando, Florida<ref name="pcf-3469-47551" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 June 2004; players to arrive by 10 am<ref name="pcf-3469-47551" />
* '''Structure:''' constructed; decklists required<ref name="pcf-3469-47551" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="pcf-3469-47551" />

The Ultimate Package gave the winner the opportunity to design a [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]], and added four boxes of cards, foils, uncut sheets and other prizes. Players were asked to print and bring their own decklists, using the form under the Resources link at [[Swccgpc.com|swccgpc.com]].<ref name="pcf-3469-47551" />
